review_scope: Independent read-only final seal and actual-artifact audit; no tests, native executable, compiler, simulator, or source edit
disposition: No Critical, Important, or Minor findings

actual_run.runtime_max_120s: configured but not independently read back
actual_run.imu_feed_proof: native returned count plus archived pointer-loop source, not per-IMU receipts

preservation.original_preparation_report: historical preparation evidence; current actual-run report is separately sealed

qualifications.boundary: Recorded offline PPM-to-grayscale input with immediate-following IMU look-ahead; no authenticated live source, causal arrival, measured clock or rig calibration, pose accuracy or health, LOCAL_NED conversion, covariance, EKF2 fusion, teacher, training, or flight qualification
